finding: The 12 'SPINEPS+VERIDAH-called L6' TotalSegmentator cases were selected by 'id 25 present in ~/bench_ts/spineps/native/*_seg-vert_msk.nii.gz'. Those masks carry vertebra INSTANCES at correct spatial positions but under spatially SCRAMBLED ids (S-I diagnostic job 40424652: every case non-monotonic; e.g. TS_s0224 id 24 topmost, id 25 at the bottom on the sacrum). 'id 25 present' therefore never meant L6. The ordered VERIDAH naming is the ctd POI json beside each mask; by it only 2 of 12 are L6, 3 are T13, and 7 are normal spines. Renders were re-made (jobs 40424662 + 40424677) from masks relabelled by ctd centroid rank-match (tools/rare_class_ts_fixids.py); anns carry the ctd subtype, overriding transitional_subtypes.csv which still lists all 12 as L6 and needs the same correction upstream (as does anomalous_inventory.json's TS section).

notes.TS_s1178: ctd names C2..T11 then L1..L6 (no T12): an 11-rib-bearing / 25-presacral pattern; L6 per VERIDAH
